failed_source_job.name: chris-q38-f8-s46-t3k32s1000-p1-v1
failed_source_job.failure: The offline Docker startup subprocess exceeded its combined 60-second timeout while running OpenCode version and database-path commands.

same_image_control.result: The identical offline version-plus-database-path command succeeded against the exact pinned image and shared bind mount.

source_finding.database_path_command: packages/opencode/src/cli/cmd/db.ts marks the command instance-free but executes it through AppRuntime.
source_finding.application_runtime: packages/opencode/src/effect/app-runtime.ts constructs the complete application service layer, including database migration and numerous unrelated services.
source_finding.conclusion: The database-path command performs much more startup work than its output suggests. Its variable cold-start duration is not evidence that the pinned image, user, HOME, or writable mount is invalid.

local_bounded_timing.scope: A local linux/amd64 image rebuilt from the exact repository Dockerfile, base-image digest and release asset; its rebuilt OS package layer means it is supporting timing evidence rather than exact-image qualification.

repair.normal_probe: Run the pinned binary once, require the exact version, require non-root execution and explicit HOME, and directly create and remove a private file in each OpenCode config, cache, state and data directory.

exact_image_qualification.result: Five consecutive semantic startup trials passed against the exact pinned image without creating a database or launching an evaluation.
